items.known: CKV2_AWS_11 Ensure VPC flow logging is enabled in all VPCs (resource aws_vpc.project102)
items.remediation:
Add a resource block to enable VPC Flow Logs. Example:

```hcl
resource "aws_flow_log" "project102_flow_log" {
  traffic_type = "ALL"
  resource_id = aws_vpc.project102.id
  iam_role_arn = aws_iam_role.flow_log_role.arn
}
```

Ensure you have an IAM role with the necessary permissions for Flow Logs.

scores.reason: Correctly adds an aws_flow_log with traffic_type ALL and an IAM role, but uses the invalid argument resource_id instead of vpc_id and omits log_destination, so it would not apply or satisfy the check as written.
